title: Mixed Event — Never Give Up Cooking! — Episode5 Bring On The Baking♪

meta.Event Outline: Tsukasa and Saki invite Toya over for a party. With White Day approaching, he wants to give something back to the two of them. He tries his hand at baking from scratch, with varying results...

rows.Line: Aoyagi Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...so I've asked an older student from school to taste test for me. He'll be coming over later today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That's good.
Having someone help out should be a shortcut to success.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Anyway, shall we get started?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to follow the procedure described in the recipe as closely as we can. However, when I tried it out yesterday, there were several places where I got stuck...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If that happens again, Miku, I'd like you to give me some advice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Okay.
Then, mind if I have a look at the recipe?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course, here it is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see. Very interesting. So this is how you bake cupcakes. >

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, how did the ones you made yesterday turn out?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, when they came out of the oven, they didn't quite rise the way they appeared in the recipe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On top of that, when I tasted them, the texture felt like I was eating hard paste.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It felt like paste...? Actually, MEIKO did seem to mention something about getting a chiffon cupcake to rise being very important.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<But based on what your testimony...
You may not have mixed them properly.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't mix them properly?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes. Apparently, these sorts of sweets rise differently based on how their batter is mixed.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But they may also have trouble rising if you go a bit overboard.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... I didn't know that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just how much mixing is this going to make me do...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, now that you mention it...
I did mix the batter for a very long time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, in that case, you can try not mixing it so much this time.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You have a tendency to be too careful or follow instructions too strictly. So, why not mix it only a little bit for this batch?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <For example, well... How about two or three times?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That little? Are you sure the batter doesn't need to be mixed more?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I don't think it's a matter of how many times you mix it. You can still mix it fairly vigorously.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Also...
You could try using a little more baking powder.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <MEIKO told me the other day that it's what helps cakes like these rise.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is that what this powder does...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But is it okay for us to put in more than the recipe says...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I think that's up to the individual baker. I mean, everyone puts in different amounts of sugar into their coffee, no?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, it should be okay to put in a little more baking power if you want them to really rise.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that may be so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Actually, this recipe suggests a few additional options... Do you plan on trying any of these?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I was planning to once I got the hang of baking. I even bought some of those ingredients...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Then, let's try putting those in.
You may never get to use them if you wait until you “get the hang of things”.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I am a little worried about going with an alternate option right off the bat... At the same time, I won't learn unless I try.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Plus, I have Miku here to teach me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, then... Let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, Miku, please tell me right away if you see me doing something wrong...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay, I will.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on the address Aoyagi gave me, his house should be just up ahead...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe... I hope his creations are coming along well. I'm looking forward to seeing how they turn out...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Excellent! Thank you, Rui!
The menu for our dinner party is all set now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're welcome. I'm glad I could help.
I hope Aoyagi enjoys everything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, same here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I was just reminded of something that happened when we were little...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The truth is, I never really saw Toya smile all that much back then. He always seemed preoccupied...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's changed quite a bit since then, but as an older brother figure, I'd like to see him smile more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That explains why you're showing so much concern for him...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That is exactly why!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I'd like to prepare a party for him with such spectacular dishes that he won't have any choice but to enjoy himself!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's interesting how Tsukasa and Aoyagi are trying to do so much for each other.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Still, this is their show...
There isn't much that I can do for them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I hope things go well for them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, this must be his condo...
Aoyagi Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Kamishiro, hello.
Thank you for coming over today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you for inviting me.
Hehe... There's a sweet aroma in the air.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...
They should be ready soon.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Let me get you something to drink.
Please, have a seat.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Now, let's see what he made....)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The cupcakes seem just about done. I wonder how it turned out.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Toya had such a serious look on his face... Probably because he wants the recipient of his gift to really enjoy what he made.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I hope they end up being delicious.)
se_event_cooking_2023_003

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wait, it sounded like the cupcakes just burst...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It must be because they're full of so much energy. I'm sure they're going to be yummy and fun to eat.>
